memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "But Laban said to him, 'If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the LORD has blessed me because of you.' He added, 'Name your wages, and I will pay them.' Jacob said to him, 'You know how I have worked for you and how your livestock has fared under my care. The little you had before I came has increased greatly, and the LORD has blessed you wherever I have been. But now, when may I do something for my own household?'" - Gen 30:27-30 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Laban does not want Jacob to leave, and he admits why: "the LORD has blessed me because of you." Even Laban, a scheming man, could see that God's blessing had come to his household through Jacob. Wherever Jacob went, prosperity followed — not because Jacob was so clever, but because God was with him, just as He had promised at Bethel.

This is a beautiful pattern that runs through Scripture. God had promised Abraham that through his family "all peoples on earth will be blessed" (Gen 12:3), and here we see it in miniature: Jacob's presence brings blessing even to an undeserving man like Laban. God's people become channels of His goodness to those around them.

The same can be true of us. When God's people live and work faithfully, others are often blessed through them — families, workplaces, neighbourhoods. We may not always see it, but the presence of a faithful believer can be a quiet means of God's kindness to many.

This blessing flows fully through Jesus Christ, Abraham's greatest descendant, through whom God pours out grace on people of every nation (Gal 3:14). As we walk with Him, we too can become a blessing wherever we go. Ask God to make your life a channel of His goodness to others.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is my presence a blessing to the people and places around me?
2. Do I see God's hand in the good that flows through faithful lives?
3. How can I be a channel of God's kindness where I live and work?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, make my life a channel of Your blessing to those around me. Let others sense Your goodness through my faithfulness, for Your glory and their good. Amen.
